title: Approximation bound for repeated coordinates
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$ with $m>0$, let $P\in\mathbb R$, let $d_{ij}$ be real numbers indexed by $1\le i\le n$ and $1\le j\le m$, let $g_i\in\mathbb R$, and let $e\ge0$. If $|d_{ij}-g_i/\sqrt m|\le e$ for every $i,j$, then $\sqrt{P^2+\sum_{i=1}^n\sum_{j=1}^m d_{ij}^2}\le\sqrt{P^2+\sum_{i=1}^n g_i^2}+\sqrt{nm}\,e$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $m>0$, $P\in\mathbb R$, $d\in\mathbb R^{n\times m}$, $g\in\mathbb R^n$, and $e\ge0$. If $|d_{ij}-g_i/\sqrt m|\le e$ for every $i,j$, then $\sqrt{P^2+\sum_{i,j}d_{ij}^2}\le\sqrt{P^2+\sum_i g_i^2}+\sqrt{nm}\,e$.
